blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.
blocks.zh: 废物自动分类支持源头分离,从而能够回收和使危险医疗物品远离家庭废物。 废物分类研究经常在随机图像分割上报告近乎完美的准确性,这把一个物品的照片放在培训和测试集中. 为了衡量分类人员如何识别从未见过的物品,我们建造了BanglaWaste-23,在来自孟加拉国的23个家庭和医疗废物类别中有4,160幅172件物品的图像。 每个图像还记录它显示的物理物品. 我们评估了11个ImageNet预先训练的模型和两个从零开始训练的模型(一个紧凑的定制网络和MobileNetV3-L),使用对象脱节的5倍交叉验证和随机的分割. 在隐形物体上,最好的预训模型达到了宏观平均F1的98.8%的分数,有6个模型在统计上捆绑. 随机从切片精度中多报15至19个百分点. 切除模型也漏掉了11%至13%的医疗物品,而预训模型的误差不到1%。 在来自达卡的第二个数据集中,预训精度下降了15至22分. 因此,分类器应在看不见的物体上加以评价,随机分解的结果应读作上限。 有关数据见Zenodo和代码https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Municipal solid waste is growing quickly. The world produced about 2.1 billion tonnes of it in 2020, and this amount is
expected to reach 3.8 billion tonnes by 2050 [ 1 ] . Much of this waste could be recycled or composted if it were
separated where it is produced. Separation at the source is therefore a central step in waste management. Automatic recognition
of discarded items could support this step.

Medical waste makes separation more urgent. About 85% of the waste from health-care activities is comparable to household waste. The remaining 15% is hazardous because it may be infectious, chemical or radioactive [ 2 ] . This hazardous part must be kept apart from household waste. In Bangladesh, national plans call for waste segregation from households to landfills. These plans, however, are not yet
fully implemented [ 3 ] . In one district hospital, infectious waste that had been separated at the source was
later mixed with other waste and handed over for municipal dumping [ 4 ] . In a hospital in Rajshahi, only a third of the waste bins were fully colour-coded [ 5 ] . Hospital items and household items
can therefore end up in the same waste stream.

blocks.en:

very high accuracies [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] .

blocks.en:
These accuracies, however, depend on how the test images were chosen. Waste datasets usually contain several photographs of each
physical item, taken from different angles or on different backgrounds. Most waste studies divide such datasets at random, image
by image (Section 2.3 ). Views of the same item then appear in both the training and the test set. A model can
therefore succeed by recognising an item that it has already seen. In other fields,
leaky splits of this kind are known to inflate results [ 12 , 13 ] . Two further gaps limit
current work. Only one public dataset that we found contains medical items collected in a hospital [ 14 ] . In
addition, models are rarely tested on images from another region.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we address these gaps with a new dataset and a careful benchmark. Our aim is to measure how well waste classifiers recognise physical items that they have never seen, and how much a random image-level split changes this picture. Our contributions are as follows. First, we release BanglaWaste-23, a dataset of 4,160 images of 172 physical objects in 23
household and medical waste classes, with an object ID and capture metadata for every image. Second, we define an
object-disjoint five-fold benchmark with released split files and evaluate 11 pretrained models and two models trained from
scratch under one tuned recipe. Third, we show how much a random image-level split overstates accuracy on unseen objects, and
why this effect differs between pretrained models and models trained from scratch. Fourth, we analyse medical-waste errors,
per-object difficulty, image-quality shortcuts, model attention and transfer to a second Bangladeshi dataset from another region.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Waste image datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 废物图像数据集

blocks.en:
Public waste image datasets differ mainly in where and how the images were taken (Table 1 ). TrashNet
contains 2,527 images of six material classes, photographed one item at a time on a white board [ 15 ] .
RealWaste contains 4,808 images of nine classes taken at a landfill in Australia [ 16 ] . TACO collects
crowdsourced photographs of litter in the wild and annotates them for detection [ 17 ] . ZeroWaste records
cluttered items on the conveyor belt of a recycling facility [ 18 ] . Other datasets are built from web images or merged from earlier sets [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] . TrashBox, for example, has 17,785 web images, and TrashNeXt merges public sets into 23,625 images. In such collections, it is hard to tell whether two images show the same item.

回收设施运输带上的杂乱物品[18]. 其他数据集由网络图像构建,或由早期的数据集合并[19,20,21]. 例如TrashBox拥有17,785个网络图像,TrashNeXt将公共集合并为23,625个图像. 在这样的集合中,很难分辨两个图像是否显示同一个项目.

blocks.en:
Medical waste appears in only a few of these datasets. Zhou et al. [14] collected 3,480 images of eight medical classes
in a hospital in China. The Medical Waste 4.0 dataset contains photographs of new, unused medical items taken in two rooms [ 22 ] . In TrashBox, ConvoWaste and TrashNeXt, the medical images come from the web or from merged public
sets [ 19 , 23 , 20 ] . Bangladesh has one earlier waste image dataset.
BDWaste contains 2,497 images of 20 classes collected from roadsides and dustbins in Dhaka [ 6 ] . It
includes gloves, masks and empty medicine packets. It contains no items collected at a hospital. Finally, none of the datasets
in Table 1 releases an object identity for each image.

blocks.en: 2.2 Deep learning for waste classification
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 深入学习废物分类

blocks.en:
Most recent waste classification studies fine-tune convolutional neural networks (CNNs) or transformers that were
pretrained on ImageNet [ 24 ] . Rahman et al. [6] trained MobileNetV2 and InceptionV3 on BDWaste and reported accuracies of up to 99.70%. Gurcan and Soylu [7] compared 14 pretrained CNNs on a 12-class Kaggle dataset, and ConvNeXt was the best model with
96.95%. Alkılınç et al. [9] combined several CNNs in ensembles and reached 95.8 to 99.1% on four public datasets. Goyal et al. [10] designed a custom CNN for six waste classes and reported an accuracy of 98.54%.
Transformer and hybrid designs have also been used, such as a vision transformer on TrashNet [ 25 ] , a Swin and
ConvNeXt hybrid [ 8 ] and CNN and vision transformer hybrids for nine waste types [ 11 ] . In parallel, several studies propose compact custom CNNs, sometimes trained
with knowledge distillation [ 26 ] . Lightweight CNNs have also been paired with explanation methods such as local interpretable model-agnostic explanations (LIME) [ 27 ] . Other studies detect and locate several waste items in one image. Chen et al. [28] used transfer learning for this task on a self-built dataset. Xiao et al. [29] created training images by fusing waste items onto complex backgrounds. For medical waste, Zhou et al. [14] reached 97.2% with a
fine-tuned ResNeXt-50.

在ImageNet上预训 [24]. 拉赫曼等人著. [6] 在BDWaste上对MobileNetV2和InceptionV3进行了培训,并报告了高达99.70%的速率. Gurcan和Soylu [7] 在12级的Kaggle数据集上比较了14个预先训练过的CNN,ConvNEXt是最佳的型号.

微调ResNEXt-50.

blocks.en:
The way these results are reported makes them hard to compare and to carry over to practice. Most studies give a single
accuracy from one split, without a confidence interval. Only two of the studies that we reviewed ran significance tests. Some
fine-tune only the classifier layer and keep the pretrained backbone frozen [ 6 , 7 ] .
Measured speed on a phone or an embedded device is reported only rarely [ 25 , 30 ] . When
images from several real sources were combined, classification accuracy reached only 74.6% [ 31 ] . A
review of computer vision for waste sorting also noted that many studies use simplified settings or artificially collected
data [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh:
报告这些结果的方式使其难以比较并付诸实践。 多数研究只给出一个
精确度从一个拆分,没有置信间隔。 我们审查的研究中只有两项是重大测试。 有点
仅对分类器层进行微调,并保持预训骨干冻结[6,7].
在电话或嵌入式设备上测量速度的报告很少[25,30]. 何时
合并了几个真实来源的图像,分类精度仅达到74.6% [31]. A级
对计算机废物分类设想的审查也指出,许多研究使用简化设置或人工收集
数据 [32].

blocks.en: 2.3 Data leakage and shortcut learning
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 数据泄漏和快捷键学习

blocks.en:
Data leakage occurs when information about the test data is available during training. Kapoor and Narayanan [12] documented
leakage in machine-learning studies across many scientific fields and grouped its causes into a taxonomy. In brain imaging,
splitting the image slices of one patient between training and test sets inflated classification accuracy compared with a
split by patient [ 13 ] . Varoquaux and Cheplygina [33] describe such evaluation failures in medical imaging and
recommend practices that avoid them. A related problem is shortcut learning, in which a model relies on a simple cue, such as
the background or the image quality, instead of the object itself [ 34 ] . Visual explanation methods such as gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) help to check where a model
looks [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据泄漏是在培训期间获得测试数据信息时发生的。 卡普尔和纳拉亚南[12]
在许多科学领域进行机器学习研究的渗漏,并将其原因归类为分类学。 在脑成像中
将一名病人的图像切片在培训与测试组合之间分开,将分类精度与
由病人分开 [13]. Varoquaux 和 Cheplygina [33] 描述了医学成像和
建议避免这些做法。 一个相关的问题是快捷键学习,其中一个模型依赖于一个简单的提示,例如:
背景或图像质量,而不是对象本身 [34] 。 视觉解释方法,如梯度加权类激活绘图(Grad-CAM)有助于检查模型在哪里
看起来[35]。

blocks.en:
Waste classification has not yet adopted this kind of evaluation. Of the 30 waste image studies that we reviewed, 20 evaluated
on image-level splits without any grouping. Another 9 did not describe the split. Only one added a test set recorded on a different
day [ 22 ] . None split the data by physical object or reported how many items were shared between the
training and test sets. We also found no study that trained on one dataset and tested on a dataset from another region. BanglaWaste-23 and its object IDs are designed to fill this gap.

The medical group has four classes (medicine blister pack, saline infusion set, syringe and used cotton wool) and 781 images (18.8%). One example

The classes are well balanced, with 141 to 211 images each (mean 180.9). The largest class is only 1.5 times the size of the
smallest. Twelve of the classes do not appear in the BDWaste dataset from Dhaka [ 6 ] . These are cucumber peel, mango leaf, orange peel, peanut shell, pointed gourd peel, pumpkin peel, watermelon rind, cloth scraps, pen, saline infusion set, syringe and used cotton wool. Several food classes are
fine-grained. Potato, mango, cucumber and pointed gourd peels, for example, look alike in colour and texture.
blocks.zh:
班级平衡良好,各有141至211幅图像(平均180.9幅). 最大的等级只有1.5倍
最小一点 其中12类没有出现在达卡的BDWaste数据集[6]. 它们是黄瓜皮、芒果叶、橙皮、花生壳、尖尖瓜皮、南瓜皮、西瓜皮、布片、笔、盐碱注入剂、注射器和用过的棉羊毛。 有几个食品类
不错 土豆,芒果,黄瓜和尖尖的瓜皮,例如,在颜色和纹理上相像.

blocks.en:
We define an object as one physical item, or one set of items of the same class photographed together. One pile of peanut
shells, for example, is one object. The dataset contains 172 objects, with 5 to 10 objects per class.
blocks.zh:
我们把一个物体定义为一个物理物品,或者一个同一类物品合拍. 一叠花生
例如,贝壳是一个对象。 该数据集包含172个对象,每类有5至10个对象.

waste, and (t)–(w) medical waste (medicine blister pack, saline infusion set, syringe and used cotton wool).
blocks.zh:
费格。 1: 孟加拉国Waste-23的23个类别中的每个类别都有一个例子:(a)-(n)食物和植物废物,(o)-(s)家庭非食物
废物,以及(t)-(w)医疗废物(医药水泡包、盐水注入装置、注射器和使用过的棉羊毛)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Screening and labelling
blocks.zh: 3.3 筛选和标签

blocks.en: Images were labelled by placing them in one folder per class. A nurse at Hasan General Hospital verified the four medical classes.
blocks.zh: 将图像贴在每类一个文件夹中。 Hasan总医院的一名护士核实了这四个医疗班。

blocks.en:
We then screened all 4,981 photographs. First, we removed images that were blurred, too dark, taken by mistake or showing
the wrong item. Next, we compared the MD5 checksums of all
files, which are short fingerprints of the file content. Six pairs of identical files were found, one in the bottle class and
five in the malta peel class. Both copies of each pair were removed, which is 12 files. Finally, we removed four peanut shell images whose shorter side was 510 or 511 pixels. These
steps removed 821 photographs (16.5%) and left 4,160 images.
blocks.zh:
然后我们放映了4 981张照片。 首先,我们删除了模糊,太暗,被误拍或显示的图像
错误的项目。 接下来我们比较了MD5的校验和
文件,是文件内容的短指纹。 发现了6对相同的文件,一个在瓶子类和
5个在麦尔塔皮层 每双的两份副本都被移除,即12份文件。 最后,我们移除了四个花生壳图像,其较短的侧面是510或511像素. 这些
步骤删除了821张照片(16.5%),留下了4,160张图像。

blocks.en:
The released images were not resized, recompressed, colour-corrected or augmented. The only edit is the cropping of 69 images
(56 peanut shell and 13 bottle images), which are marked in the metadata. In addition, 2,228 images carry an exchangeable image file
format (EXIF) tag that tells software how to rotate the image. We applied this tag before training
(Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
释放的图像没有调整大小、重新压缩、校正或增强。 唯一的编辑是剪切 69 张图像
(56个花生壳和13个瓶子图像),在元数据中标注. 此外,2 228幅图像还带有可交换的图像文件
格式 (EXIF) 标记,它告诉软件如何旋转图像。 训练前我们用过这个标签
(第4.3节)

blocks.en: 3.4 Object identities and metadata
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 对象身份和元数据

blocks.en:
Because each item was photographed many times, we grouped the screened images into objects. First, photographs taken in
sequence within each class were grouped automatically by visual similarity. Similarity was measured with features from an
ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 network [ 36 ] and with colour histograms of the image border. Next,
the team reviewed the proposed groups on contact sheets, which are pages of small thumbnails. Groups that showed the same items
in a different arrangement or on another background were merged, which gave 172 objects.
blocks.zh:
因为每件物品被拍摄过很多次, 我们把所放映的图像分成物体。 首先,拍摄的照片
每个类中的序列按视觉相似性自动分组。 类似程度的测量特征来自
ImageNet 预装的 MobileNetV2网络[36],并带有图像边框的彩色直方图. 下一个
小组在接触表中审查了拟议的小组,这些小组是小缩略语的页数。 显示相同项目的组
在一个不同的安排中或在另一个背景中合并,这给172个对象。

blocks.en:
For each object, we also recorded the setting, the lighting and the background by visual inspection. Almost all objects (170 of
172) were photographed indoors, and most of them (144) in natural daylight. Sixty-three objects were photographed on more than
one background.
blocks.zh:
对于每个物体,我们还通过目视检查记录了设定,照明和背景. 几乎所有物体(170个,
在室内拍摄了172幅照片,其中大部分(144幅)是在自然日光下拍摄的。 有63件物体被拍摄到
一个背景。

blocks.en:
Object IDs make a fair test on new items possible. Without them, a random split puts views of the same object in both the
training and the test set. With them, whole objects can be kept out of training (Section 4.1 ), and errors
can be analysed object by object (Section 5.4 ). None of the public waste datasets in
Table 1 releases such IDs.
blocks.zh:
对象ID使得对新项目进行公平测试成为可能. 如果没有它们,随机分割将同一对象的视图放入两个
培训和测试集。 有了它们,整个物体就可不接受培训(第4.1节),错误就可能
可按对象分析对象(第5.4节)。 没有任何公共废物数据集
表1公布此类身份证。

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark design
blocks.zh: 4 基准设计

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价协议

blocks.en:
The main evaluation tests every model on objects that it has never seen. We used five-fold cross-validation in which whole
objects, not single images, were assigned to folds (Fig. 2 b). Within each class,
objects were sorted from largest to smallest, and the first five were placed one per fold. Each further object went to the
fold with the fewest images of that class (random seed 42). As a result, every class appears in every fold, and no object
appears in two folds. The folds contain 740 to 936 images from 32 to 38 objects (Fig. S3 in Online Resource 1). A standard stratified group split
could not achieve this, because several classes have only five objects of unequal size. Each fold served once as the test set,
and the other four folds were used for training.
blocks.zh:
主要评价测试每个模型上它从未见过的物体. 我们用了五倍的交叉验证 在整体
对象,不是单一的图像,被指定为折叠(图2b). 每个班级,
对象从最大到最小排序,前五个被放置在每叠一个。 接下来的每个物体都进入
与该类中最少的图像(原始种子42)折叠。 因此,每个类别都出现在每个折叠中,没有对象
以两个折叠形式出现。 折叠包含32至38个对象的740至936个图像(在线资源1中的图S3). 标准分层分组
无法做到这一点,因为若干类只有5个大小不均的对象。 每张折叠都曾作为测试套装
其他四个折叠用于训练。

blocks.en:
Learning rates and the number of epochs were chosen without using any test fold. For this purpose, one object per class was
held out from the training folds of the first round, in which fold 1 is the test fold. This tuning split has 2,689 training
images and 623 validation images from 23 held-out objects.
blocks.zh:
在不使用任何测试折叠的情况下,选择了学习率和时代数。 为此,每个类别有一个对象
以第一回合的训练折叠方式进行,其中第1折叠是测试折叠。 这个调音板有2 689个训练
来自23个搁置对象的图像和623个验证图像。

blocks.en:
For comparison, we also built the kind of split that most waste studies use (Section 2.3 ). Images were
assigned at random to training, validation and test sets (70%, 15% and 15%, stratified by class). In this split, 155 of
the 172 objects have images in both the training and the test set (Fig. 2 a). We used it only to measure how
a random image-level split changes the results (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
为了比较起见,我们还建立了大多数废物研究所使用的拆分方式(第2.3节)。 图像是
随机分配给培训、鉴定和测试组(70%、15%和15%,按班级分级)。 在这场分裂中,155人
172个物体在训练和测试集中都有图像(图2a)。 我们用它来衡量
随机图像级别拆分改变结果(第5.2节)。

(b) In object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, whole objects are assigned to folds, every class is present in every fold,

(b) 国家 在对象离合的五倍交叉验证中,整个对象被指定为折叠,每个折叠中每个类都存在,
并且每个折叠都作为测试集使用一次(shown for flack 1). 学习率和时代被调整到每个课程的一个对象上
从训练折叠, 从来没有在测试折叠, 和外倍预测 所有4,160 图像集合。

blocks.en: 4.2 Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式

blocks.en:
We benchmarked 11 models pretrained on the ImageNet-1k dataset [ 24 ] . The mobile CNNs are
MobileNetV2 [ 36 ] , MobileNetV3-L [ 37 ] , MobileNetV4-S [ 38 ] , EfficientNet-B0 [ 39 ] and GhostNetV2 [ 40 ] . The larger
CNNs are ResNet-50 [ 41 ] , DenseNet-121 [ 42 ] and ConvNeXt-T [ 43 ] .
DeiT-S is a vision transformer [ 44 ] . MobileViTv2 [ 45 ] and EfficientFormerV2-S0 [ 46 ] combine convolution with attention. The models range from 2.25 to 27.84 million parameters
and from 166 to 4,599 million multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) per image (Table 2 ). All pretrained weights
were taken from the timm library [ 47 ] , and all layers were fine-tuned.
blocks.zh:
我们在ImageNet-1k数据集上对11个模型进行了预先测试 [24]. 移动的CNN是
MobileNetV2 [36],MobileNetV3-L [37],MobileNetV4-S [38],高效网-B0 [39]和GhostNetV2 [40]. 大一点
CNN是ResNet-50 [41],DenseNet-121 [42]和ConvNEXt-T [43].
DeiT-S是一台视变器[44]. MobileViTv2 [45] and effectiveFormerV2-S0 [46] 结合进化与注意力. 模型范围为2.25至2784万个参数.
从1.66亿到45.99亿次乘积操作(MAC)每幅图像(表2)。 所有预训重量
被取自Timm 库 [47], 并且所有层都被微调。

blocks.en:
We also trained two models from scratch, that is, without pretrained weights. They represent the compact custom CNNs that are
often proposed for waste classification [ 26 ] . The first is a compact custom CNN, which we call V0. It has 0.38 million parameters and needs 165 million MACs. It combines residual blocks, a multi-scale
depthwise convolution module, channel and spatial attention, and a dual-pooling head. It was implemented in PyTorch. The second is MobileNetV3-L trained from scratch. Because it shares the architecture of the pretrained
MobileNetV3-L, this pair separates the effect of pretraining from the effect of the design.
blocks.zh:
我们还从零开始训练两个模型, 即没有预先训练的重量。 它们代表了紧凑的定制CNN,即:
经常建议进行废物分类[26]。 第一个是紧凑定制的CNN,我们称之为V0. 它有38万个参数,需要1.65亿个MAC. 它结合了残块,一个多尺度
深度进化模块,通道和空间注意力, 和双池头。 它在PyTorch执行。 第二个是MobileNetV3-L从零开始训练. 因为它分享预训的建筑
MobileNetV3-L,这对将预训的效果与设计的效果区分开来.

blocks.en: 4.3 Training
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训

blocks.en:
All models were trained with one shared recipe, so that only the model changed between runs (Table S1). Images were rotated
according to their EXIF tag and resized so that the shorter side was 256 pixels. Training used random 224 × 224 224\times 224 crops,
flips, small rotations and small colour changes. With a probability of 0.5, a training batch was also mixed with MixUp [ 48 ] or CutMix [ 49 ] , which blend two images and their labels. The models were optimised
with AdamW [ 50 ] and a batch size of 32. The learning rate rose during five warm-up epochs and then
followed a cosine decay [ 51 ] . We evaluated an exponential moving average of the weights after the last
epoch [ 52 ] . No early stopping, test-time augmentation or class weighting was used. Training ran in
PyTorch [ 53 ] with timm on an NVIDIA Tesla T4 graphics processing unit (GPU).
blocks.zh:
所有模型都用一个共享的食谱进行了培训,因此只有模型在运行间发生改变(表S1)。 图像被旋转
根据他们的 EXIF 标记并调整大小,使较短的一面是256像素。 训练随机使用 224× 224\时 224作物,
翻转,小旋转和小颜色变化。 在概率为0.5的情况下,一个训练批次也与MixUp[48]或CutMix[49]混合,它们混合了两个图像及其标签. 模型被优化了
与 AdamW [50] 和32 的批量尺寸。 五个热点时期的学习率上升了 然后
尾随余弦衰变[51]. 我们评估了上次之后的指数移动平均重量
划时代 [52]. 没有使用提前停止、试验时间加固或等级加权。 培训进入
PyTorch [53] 在一个NVIDIA Tesla T4图形处理单元(GPU)上带有Timm.

blocks.en:
Each pretrained model received its own learning rate. We tried 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} on the tuning split.
We then chose the value with the highest mean validation macro-averaged F1 score (macro-F1, Section 4.4 ) over
epochs 16 to 40 (Table S2). This gives every model a fair
setting. All pretrained models were trained for 40 epochs, because their validation curves reached a plateau between epochs 20
and 40 (Fig. S4). ConvNeXt-T and DeiT-S declined afterwards. ConvNeXt-T, for example, fell from
about 93% to 89% by epoch 80, which suggests memorisation of the training objects. The two models trained from scratch used a
learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and a longer schedule of 150 epochs.
blocks.zh:
每个经过预先培训的模型都获得了自己的学习率。 我们试了10 - 3 10 - 3 - 10 - 3 - 3 - 10 - 4 3 - 10 - 4 4 - 10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 分音。
然后我们选择了最高平均验证值的F1分数(宏-F1,第4.4节),而不是
16至40世纪(表S2)。 这让每个模特都有一个公平
设置。 所有经过预先训练的模型都为40个纪元进行了训练,因为它们的验证曲线在纪元20之间达到了一个高点
和40(图S.4)。 ConvNEXt-T和DeiT-S后来下降. 例如,ConvNEXt-T从
大约93%到89% 由80世纪, 这说明纪念训练对象。 从头开始训练的两个模型使用了
学习速度为10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 ),学习时间为150个纪元。

blocks.en: 4.4 Metrics and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 计量和统计分析

blocks.en:
Macro-F1 on unseen objects is the main metric. It is the mean of the F1 scores of the 23 classes, so every class counts
equally. We also report accuracy and balanced accuracy. Each metric is given as the mean and standard deviation over
the five test folds. We also pooled the out-of-fold predictions, in which each of the 4,160 images is predicted once by a
model that never saw its object. For the pooled macro-F1, we computed a 95% confidence interval by
bootstrap [ 54 ] with 2,000 resamples. We resampled the 172 objects rather than single images, because
images of the same object are not independent [ 55 ] . To compare models, we applied the McNemar test with
continuity correction [ 56 , 57 ] to the pooled predictions of each model and of the
best model. The p p -values of the 12 comparisons were adjusted with the Holm method [ 58 ] . For cost, we report the number of parameters and the MACs per image.
blocks.zh:
不可见物体上的宏-F1是主要的衡量标准. 是23个班的F1分数的平均值 所以每个班都算数
同样。 我们还报告准确性和均衡性。 每个衡量标准作为平均和标准差值
五个测试折叠。 我们还汇集了各种外部预测,其中4,160幅图像中的每一幅都通过一个预测来预测。
从未见过它的物体的模型。 对于集合的宏-F1,我们计算95%的置信间隔由
靴子带 [54] 有2000个复标。 我们重印了172个物体 而不是单一的图像 因为
同一对象的图像不独立 [55]. 为了比较模型,我们应用了McNemar测试与
[56、57] 对每个模型和
最佳的模特儿。 12个比较的p-p值与霍尔姆法进行了调整[58]. 就成本而言,我们报告每个图像的参数和MAC的数量。

blocks.en: 4.5 Additional analyses
blocks.zh: 4.5 其他分析

blocks.en:
Five further analyses looked beyond overall accuracy. First, we counted errors between the three groups, in particular
medical images predicted as non-medical. Second, we computed the accuracy of each object. Third, we tested ConvNeXt-T and
EfficientNet-B0 for image-quality shortcuts. The test images were re-encoded as JPEG files at quality 30, or reduced to 96
pixels and enlarged again, and accuracy was compared between phones. Fourth, we computed Grad-CAM maps on fold 1 [ 35 ] . Fifth, four models trained on all 4,160 images were tested on 1,390 BDWaste images from Dhaka [ 6 ] . These images belong to the 11 classes shared by the two datasets. We report accuracy over all 23
outputs and accuracy restricted to the shared classes.
blocks.zh:
还有五项分析超出了总体准确性。 首先,我们计算出这三组人之间的错误,特别是
医学影像被预测为非医学. 第二,我们计算每个物体的准确性。 第三,我们测试了ConvNEXT和
高效 Net-B0用于图像质量快捷键. 测试图像在质量 30 时被重新编码为 JPEG 文件, 或者减少到 96
像素和再次放大,准确性在手机之间被比较. 第四,我们计算Grad-CAM地图 在折叠1 [35]。 第五,对达卡1,390个BDWaste图像进行了测试,对所有4,160幅图像进行了培训。 这些图像属于两个数据集共享的11类. 我们报告所有23人的准确性
产出和准确性仅限于共享类别。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Classification of unseen objects
blocks.zh: 5.1 不明物体的分类

blocks.en:
We first evaluated all models on unseen objects with object-disjoint cross-validation (Table 2 ). ConvNeXt-T
reached the highest pooled macro-F1 of 98.82%, with a 95% confidence interval of 94.5 to 99.4%. The interval is wide at its
lower end because the bootstrap resamples only 172 objects. All 11 pretrained models scored between 96.03 and 98.82%, and
MobileNetV4-S had the lowest score among them.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评价了在不可见物体上的所有模型,其对象不相干地交叉验证(表2 )。 ConneXt-T 数据
达到最高集合的宏F1,98.82%,95%的置信间隔为94.5%至99.4%. 间隔很广
下端,因为靴子圈只复制172个物体。 所有11个预训型号的得分在96.03%至98.82%之间,
MobileNetV4-S在其中得分最低.

blocks.en:
Six models could not be separated statistically. ResNet-50, MobileViTv2, DenseNet-121, DeiT-S and EfficientNet-B0 did not
differ significantly from ConvNeXt-T (Holm-corrected p p between 0.059 and 0.272). The other five pretrained models and both
models trained from scratch did differ ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh:
六个模型无法在统计上分开。 ResNet-50、MobileViTv2、DenseNet-121、DeiT-S和高效网-B0没有
与ConvNEXt-T(Holm校正p在0.059至0.272之间)有很大不同。 其他五个预训型号 和两种
从零开始训练的模型确实不同(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en:
Next, we related accuracy to computational cost (Fig. 3 ). EfficientNet-B0 reached 98.29% with 385 million MACs
and 4.04 million parameters. MobileViTv2 reached 98.52% with 1,412 million MACs. ConvNeXt-T needed 4,455 million MACs and 27.84
million parameters for its 98.82%. The statistically tied group therefore includes models that need 3 to 12 times less
computation than the best model. The fifth fold was the hardest for every model. On this fold, the macro-F1 of the pretrained models
fell to between 89.0 and 93.8%.
blocks.zh:
其次,我们把精确度与计算成本(图3)联系起来。 高效Net-B0达到了98.29%,拥有3.85亿MAC。
和404万参数。 MobileViTv2达到了98.52%,拥有14.12亿MAC. ConvNEXt-T需要44.55亿MAC和27.84亿MAC
其98.82%的百万参数。 因此,统计挂钩的类别包括需要减少3至12倍的模型
计算比最好的模型。 第五叠对每个模特来说都是最难的 在此折叠上,预试模型的宏- F1
下降至89.0%至93.8%。

blocks.en: 5.2 Random versus object-disjoint evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 随机评价与对象分离评价

blocks.en:
We then repeated the evaluation with a random image-level split (Fig. 4 , and Table S3 in Online Resource 1). On this split,
ConvNeXt-T, MobileViTv2 and the pretrained MobileNetV3-L all reached a macro-F1 of 100.0%. On unseen objects, the same models
reached 98.82, 98.52 and 97.91%. The gap was therefore only 1.2 to 2.1 percentage points. However, the random split gave all
three models exactly the same score. It could not show which of them generalises better.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们用随机图像级别拆分(图4,在线资源1中的表S3)来重复评价。 在这段时间里

三个模型的得分完全一样 它无法显示其中哪一个比较笼统。

blocks.en:
The gap was much larger for the models trained from scratch. The custom CNN V0 reached 96.87% on the random split and 81.42%
on unseen objects, a gap of 15.4 points. MobileNetV3-L trained from scratch fell from 98.21 to 79.54%, a gap of 18.7 points. On
the random split, this model was only 1.8 points below its pretrained version. On unseen objects, it was 18.4 points below. The
random split thus made a weak model look almost as good as a strong one.

blocks.zh: 5.3 医疗废物和组级错误

Next, we examined the errors that matter most for sorting, which are those that cross a group boundary
(Table 3 ). All pretrained models assigned 99.30 to 99.95% of the images to the correct group. Their recall
for medical waste was between 99.10 and 100%. At most 7 of the 781 medical images were predicted as non-medical, by

blocks.en: 5.4 Difficult classes and objects
blocks.zh: 5.4 困难类别和对象

blocks.en:
We then looked at which classes caused the remaining errors (Fig. S5, Table S4). For the pretrained models, the lowest F1
scores were found in four peel classes, namely potato, pointed gourd, cucumber and mango. ConvNeXt-T, for example, reached 91.7%
for potato peel and 95.4 to 97.0% for the other three. All its other classes scored between 97.6 and 100%. These peels were
mostly confused with other food residues, such as another peel or peanut shells (Figs. S6 and S7).

我们接着研究了哪些班级造成其余错误(图S5,表S4)。 对于预训型号,最低F1

Object IDs showed that these errors were concentrated in a few objects (Table S5). One potato peel object with seven images was
misclassified by all 11 pretrained models. One mango peel object with seven images was recognised in only 10.4% of cases on
average, and one lemon object with six images in 45.5%. A larger potato peel object with 48 images reached 80.1%. Three of
the five hardest objects belong to the fifth fold, which explains why this fold was the hardest for every model. Such failures
stay hidden when results are reported only per class or per image.

对象ID显示这些错误集中在少数对象(表S5). 一个马铃薯皮物体 和七个图像

在只报告每个类别或每个图像的结果时保持隐藏。

blocks.en: 5.5 Effect of image quality and device
blocks.zh: 5.5 图像质量和装置的影响

blocks.en:
We next tested whether the models relied on image quality rather than on the waste item itself (Fig. 5 b,
Table S6). This check matters because all malta peel images are small, low-resolution files that a model could learn to detect. Strong JPEG compression lowered the

97.43 to 96.06 and 94.71%. The losses were therefore 1.3 to 2.7 points. If a model had used file quality as a cue, degraded
images of other classes would have been predicted as malta peel. This happened for no image with ConvNeXt-T and for four images
with EfficientNet-B0.

We also compared accuracy between phones within the same class (Table S7). Thirteen classes were photographed with two phones.

Section 5.4 were all photographed with the Galaxy M31. The difference therefore reflects object difficulty rather

blocks.en: 5.6 Cross-region test

blocks.en:
Finally, we tested the models on images from another region (Fig. 5 a, Table S8). On the 1,390 BDWaste images
from Dhaka, with predictions restricted to the 11 shared classes, MobileNetV3-L reached the highest accuracy of 83.0%. ConvNeXt-T
reached 80.1%, EfficientNet-B0 76.0% and the custom CNN V0 55.8%. For the pretrained models, the restricted accuracy was 15 to 22 points below their accuracy on unseen objects of
BanglaWaste-23.

blocks.en: 5.7 Visual explanations
blocks.zh: 5.7 视觉解释

blocks.en:
Grad-CAM maps showed where the models looked when they made a prediction (Figs. S8 to S15). The pretrained models focused
on the waste item itself, such as the barrel of a syringe, a blister pack or an eggshell. The two models trained from scratch
produced patchy maps. These maps often covered the background, for example the white area above a mango leaf or the ring around
an orange peel. The maps come from one fold and are qualitative. They suggest that the models trained from scratch rely partly on
background cues. They do not prove it.
blocks.zh:
Grad-CAM地图显示模型在作出预测时的外观(图. S8至S15). 训练有素的模型
在废品本身,例如注射器的桶、水泡包或蛋壳。 两个模特从零开始训练
绘制了补丁地图。 这些地图常常覆盖背景,例如芒果叶上方的白色区域或周围的环状区域.
一个橙皮。 这些地图来自一个折叠,具有质量。 他们表示,从零开始训练的模型部分依赖
背景提示 。 他们不能证明这一点。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Automatic sorting is only useful if it works on items that the system has never seen. Waste classification studies often
report accuracies close to 100%. Most of them, however, test on images of the same items that were used for training. It was
therefore unclear how much of this accuracy remains for new items. It was also unclear how safe the errors are for medical
waste and how well the models work in another region. Our results lead to three main findings.
blocks.zh:
自动排序只有在系统从未见过的项目上起作用才有用。 废物分类研究经常进行
报告速度接近100%。 不过,其中大多数人对培训所用的相同物品的图像进行了测试。 这是
因此,不清楚新项目仍有多少准确性。 还不清楚这些错误对医疗来说有多安全
废物和模型在另一个区域如何运作。 我们的结果导致三个主要结果。

blocks.en: 6.1 What random splits hide
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 随机分割隐藏

blocks.en:
First, a random image-level split does not measure what a sorting system needs. In our random split, 155 of the 172 objects
had images in both the training and the test set. The test therefore asked a model to recognise an item that it had already
seen from another angle. Every pretrained model passed this test perfectly. As a result, the random split could not rank the
models. Object-disjoint evaluation, in contrast, separated them clearly.
blocks.zh:
首先,随机的图像级别分割并不能测量排序系统需要什么. 在我们的随机分裂中 172个物体中的155个
训练场和测试场都有画面 因此,测试要求一个模型来识别它已经拥有的物品
从另一个角度来看 每个经过预先训练的模型都完美地通过了这个测试. 因此,随机拆分无法对
模特儿们 反之,物体离散评价将它们明确分开。

blocks.en:
The random split also hid the failure of models trained from scratch. The same MobileNetV3-L architecture was nearly perfect on
the random split and lost about 18 points on unseen objects. The cause is therefore training from scratch on only 5 to 10
objects per class, not one particular design. The custom CNN V0 showed the same pattern, with 96.9% on the random split and 81.4% on unseen objects. Compact custom CNNs trained from scratch are common in the waste
literature, and most studies evaluate on random splits (Section 2.3 ). Their reported accuracies should
therefore be read as an upper bound for unseen items. Such results remain valid for items that were seen during training.
They answer a different and easier question.
blocks.zh:
随机分裂也隐藏了从零开始训练的模型的失败. 同样的MobileNetV3-L架构几乎完美
随机分解 并损失了约18点 在看不见的物体。 因此,原因只有5至10日从零开始训练
每个类的物体, 不是一个特定的设计。 自定义的CNN V0显示了同样的模式,随机分拆率为96.9%,未见物体为81.4%. 从零开始训练的定制CNN在废物中很常见
,大多数研究都评价随机分裂(第2.3节)。 其报告的速度应
故应视其为无形事物的上限。 这种结果对于在培训期间看到的物品仍然有效。
他们回答一个不同和容易的问题。

blocks.en: 6.2 Implications for waste-sorting systems
blocks.zh: 6.2 对废物分类系统的影响

blocks.en:
Second, medical waste was handled safely only by pretrained models. The models trained from scratch missed about 11 to 13 of
every 100 medical items. In a sorting system, these items would be treated as ordinary household waste. Health-care waste is a
small part of all waste. A part of it, however, is hazardous [ 2 ] . The pretrained models missed at
most 7 of 781 medical images, and four of them missed none. For medical waste, the number of medical items sent to other
classes is therefore a more useful figure than overall accuracy.
blocks.zh:
第二,医疗废物只能通过预先训练过的模型安全处理。 从零开始训练的模特儿少了大约11到13个
每100个医疗物品。 在分类系统中,这些物品将作为普通生活垃圾处理。 医疗废物
一点点的浪费。 然而,其中一部分是危险的。 预训模型错过了
781张医疗照片中,大多数7张,其中4张没有错过。 对于医疗废物,送往其他废物的医疗物品数量
因此,分类比总体准确性更有用。

blocks.en:
Third, small pretrained models were accurate enough on unseen objects. They did not, however, transfer well to another region.
EfficientNet-B0 was statistically tied with ConvNeXt-T at about one-twelfth of the computation. This makes it a reasonable
choice for low-cost sorting hardware. We did not measure speed on such hardware, so this point rests on the number of
operations only. On BDWaste images from Dhaka, the accuracy of the pretrained models fell by 15 to 22 points, and no model
recognised mango peel. A model trained in one city therefore needs images from the new location, and probably some local
fine-tuning, before it is used there.
blocks.zh:
第三,小型预训模型在看不见的物体上足够精确. 然而,它们并没有很好地转移到另一个地区。
高效 Net-B0在统计上与ConvNEXt-T绑定,大约为计算结果的十二分之一. 这样才合理
选择低成本排序硬件。 我们没有测量这种硬件的速度,所以这个点取决于
仅限操作。 在来自达卡的BDWaste图像上,预训模型的精度下降了15到22分,没有模型
认得的芒果皮 因此,在一个城市训练的模型需要新地点的图像,也许需要一些当地图像。
微调,在使用之前。

blocks.en:
These findings lead to three suggestions for future waste datasets and studies. Results should be reported on unseen objects
with confidence intervals. Object IDs should be released together with the images. Where possible, models should also be tested
on data from another site.
blocks.zh:
这些研究结果为今后的废物数据集和研究提出了三项建议。 应在隐形物体上报告结果
与信心间隔。 对象ID应与图像一起发布. 在可能的情况下,还应测试模型
数据。

blocks.en: 6.3 Pretraining and architecture
blocks.zh: 6.3 预先培训和结构

blocks.en:
In a pilot on the validation objects of the
tuning split (Table S9 in Online Resource 1), the custom CNN V0 trained from scratch reached a macro-F1 of 70.8%. Knowledge distillation from
ConvNeXt-T [ 59 ] raised it to 74.2%. The pretrained
MobileNetV3-L reached 90.2% on the same objects. Adding our multi-scale and attention modules to this backbone gave
87.3% without distillation and 91.1% with it, within about one point of the plain backbone. These are single validation runs and should be read with caution. They still show that, with 5 to 10 objects per
class, pretraining mattered far more than the architecture. Larger and more varied datasets may be needed before changes to the architecture show a clear benefit.
blocks.zh:
在验证对象试验中
调制拆分(Online Resources 1中的表S9),从零开始训练的自定义CNN V0达到了70.8%的宏F1. 知识蒸馏
ConvNEXt-T [59]将其提升至74.2%. 预训
MobileNetV3-L在同一天体上达到了90.2%. 将我们的多尺度和关注模块添加到这个主干上

班级 预训比建筑更重要 在结构的改变显示出明显的好处之前,可能需要更大和更多样化的数据集。

blocks.en: 6.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.4 限制

blocks.en:
We acknowledge that this study has a few limitations. The images come from two districts and one hospital. Each class has 5 to
10 objects, so the confidence intervals are fairly wide. Object IDs were assigned by visual grouping and a manual review, so a
few views of the same item may still fall into different objects. Most items were photographed one at a time and indoors.
Sorting lines, in contrast, handle mixed and overlapping waste. Finally, we report computational cost but not speed on a
device. These points are addressed in the future work outlined in Section 7 .
blocks.zh:
我们承认,这项研究有一些局限性。 照片来自两个区和一个医院。 每门课有5至
10个物体,所以置信间隔相当宽. 对象ID通过视觉分组和手动审查来指定,所以
对同一项目的意见很少可能仍然属于不同的对象。 大多数物品都是在室内一次拍摄。
相对而言,分类线处理混合和重叠的废物。 最后,我们报告计算成本,但不报告速度
设备。 这些要点将在第7节概述的未来工作中述及。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This study introduced BanglaWaste-23, an image dataset of household and hospital waste from northern Bangladesh in which every
image is linked to the physical object that it shows. We used the object IDs to build an object-disjoint benchmark and
evaluated 11 pretrained models and two models trained from scratch on objects that they had never seen.
blocks.zh:
这项研究引入了孟加拉Waste-23,这是孟加拉国北部家庭和医院废物的图像数据集,其中每个废物都来自孟加拉国北部。
图像与其显示的物理对象相连。 我们用对象ID来构建对象离合基准,
评估了11个经过预先训练的模型和两个从头到尾训练的模型,这些模型来自从未见过的物体。

blocks.en:
Pretrained models recognised unseen objects almost perfectly, and small models such as EfficientNet-B0 were as accurate as much
larger ones. They also kept medical items apart from household waste with very few errors. A random image-level split, in
contrast, gave every pretrained model a perfect score and could not rank them. It also hid a loss of 15 to 19 percentage points
for models trained from scratch, which missed far more medical items. On images from Dhaka, all models lost accuracy, and some
classes were not recognised at all.
blocks.zh:
预先训练过的模型几乎完美地识别了看不见的物体,效率网-B0等小型模型也同样准确
{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}大一点的 他们还将医疗物品与家庭垃圾分开存放,很少出错。 随机图像级别拆分, 在
反之,给每个预先训练过的模特一个完美的分数,不能给他们排级. 还隐瞒了15到19个百分点的损失
从零开始训练的模特 错过了更多医疗物品 在达卡的图像上,所有模型都丧失了准确性,有些模型
课程根本没有得到承认。

blocks.en:
These results come from two districts, one hospital and single items photographed mostly indoors. They do not yet show how the
models behave on mixed waste in a real sorting line. Even so, they lead to a clear lesson for waste-sorting research. Accuracy
should be measured on unseen objects, and results from random image-level splits should be read as an upper bound. The dataset,
its object IDs and our split files are released to support this practice.
blocks.zh:
这些结果来自两个区、一个医院和大多在室内拍摄的单件物品。 他们还没有显示
模型在真正的分类线上表现在混合废物上. 即使如此,它们也为废物分类研究提供了明确的教训。 准确性
,并且随机图像级别拆分的结果应读作上限。 数据集,
其对象 ID 和 我们的拆分文件被发布支持此操作 。

blocks.en:
This work is a necessary first step towards reliable image-based sorting of household and medical waste. Future work will add
more regions and hospitals, extend the data to mixed-waste scenes and object detection, and measure speed on low-cost devices.
blocks.zh:
这项工作是朝着以形象为基础对家庭和医疗废物进行可靠分类迈出的必要的第一步。 今后的工作将增加
更多地区和医院,将数据扩展至混合废物场景和物品检测,并测量低成本设备的速度。
